subject.title: [security] Non-Bearer authorization header values can bypass diagnostic redaction

question: Should Crabbox harden the common diagnostic redactors so Authorization and Proxy-Authorization consume the full header value for every syntactically valid scheme?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but this changes a security boundary and should be explicitly blessed before automation opens or lands the fix.

options.title: Harden the shared redactors
options.body: Update the Go and Worker helpers together and add focused non-Bearer scheme tests while preserving current exact-secret and structured credential redaction.

options.title: Keep provider-local mitigation only
options.body: Rely on exact-secret and provider-specific redactors, accepting that the documented generic authorization-header fallback remains incomplete.

recommendation.title: Harden the shared redactors
recommendation.body: Update the Go and Worker helpers together and add focused non-Bearer scheme tests while preserving current exact-secret and structured credential redaction.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared redaction boundary and security docs trace most directly to this recent history.
